about: The contract between the native app and its JavaScript engine (ios/architecture.md D3, US-25 AC18). The app's bridge id is the first 16 hex digits of this file's SHA-256 (EngineRelease.bridge in Swift); a downloaded engine is accepted only for the same id. Any change here is a new bridge, so an engine that needs it waits for an app update. bridge.test.ts and EngineBridgeContractTests.swift fail if either side drifts from this file.

natives.http: (method, url, headersJson, body ArrayBuffer|null, done(status, statusText, headersJson, body ArrayBuffer|null, error|null)) -> id. Swift sends only the allow-listed provider calls; an Authorization header must be 'Bearer native-token:<provider>', which Swift swaps for the real token.
natives.accessToken: (provider 'dropbox'|'google-drive', force, done(token|null, error|null, signIn)). The token is the sentinel 'native-token:<provider>', never the real one.
natives.pending: ('get'|'set'|'clear-if:<generation>') -> the marker's generation after (0: not set); 'set' raises it, 'clear-if' clears only that generation

values.schemaVersion: number, the record schema the engine writes

cloudLabImport.returns: cloudEdit's JSON outcome with the labSaveSummary taken in the same step (US-52 AC8)

documentSave.returns: Promise of JSON: {ok, record, erase?, saved, unstored, stored} or {ok:false, reason, message}; files one document or a lab report's original through health-core's saveDocuments (US-52 AC13d)

labReviewJson.returns: lab review JSON, with the document card (US-52 AC13d)

convertJson.returns: {value, text, feetInches|null} JSON: a typed value in the other units by health-core's factors, for onboarding's entry-only unit switches (US-54 AC6)

screenJson.returns: {myData: MyData, plan: {sections: [PlanSection], tiles: [StatTile], ms} or {error, planError}} JSON from one read and one computePlan: My data and the Plan tab's layout and summary tiles, the web's Quick Stats (US-25 AC2, AC22), each tile with its required `about` line (US-57 AC5); tiles [] when they cannot be drawn; ms the whole milliseconds from computePlan through the tiles and the layout; planError true for health-core's PlanError; throws when My data cannot be drawn

fileNamesJson.returns: JSON array: each file's sourceFileName by health-core's rules (zipMemberName for {zip, path}, fileNameLine and the 255 cap for {name}), one call per read (US-52 AC13d)

settledJson.returns: the last settled async door's answer
